hero.title: Redefining information technology in society
hero.sub: Codeqlick designs and builds custom software and web applications that help businesses work better — from the first idea to launch and beyond.

services.title: What we build
services.lead: End-to-end digital products, designed around your business and built to last.

web.title: Web applications
web.body: SaaS platforms, client portals, dashboards and internal tools built for performance and scale.

custom.title: Custom software
custom.body: Tailor-made tools that fit your processes: automation, back-office systems, APIs and integrations.

mobile.title: Mobile & PWA
mobile.body: Responsive and progressive web apps that work beautifully on any device.

design.title: UI/UX design
design.body: Research, prototypes and design systems that make products intuitive and consistent.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.body: Architecture reviews, technology choices, MVP scoping and legacy modernization.

support.title: Maintenance & support
support.body: Monitoring, fixes, security updates and continuous improvement after launch.

process.title: From idea to launch, in clear steps
process.lead: Two-week sprints and a demo at the end of each one — you always see real progress.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.body: Goals, users and scope. You get a clear brief and estimate.

design.title: Design
design.body: Flows, prototypes and the right architecture.

development.title: Development
development.body: Two-week sprints with a demo at the end of each.

qa.title: QA
qa.body: Automated and manual testing before every release.

support.title: Support
support.body: Fixes, updates and new features as you grow.

why.title: Technology with a purpose
why.lead: We focus on what your software changes for your business and the people who use it — not just on features.

endToEnd.title: End-to-end
endToEnd.body: One partner from the first idea to launch and support.

quality.title: Quality by default
quality.body: Tested, maintainable and secure code you can build on.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.body: Clear estimates, honest updates and no surprises.

modern.title: Modern stack
modern.body: Proven, up-to-date technology chosen for each project.

work.title: Recent projects
work.lead: A few of the products we've designed and built with our clients.

contact.title: Have an idea? Let's build it.
contact.body: Tell us about your project and we'll get back to you within one business day.
